name: My carpet is soaked with water. What should I do first?

mainEntity.name: My carpet is soaked with water. What should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately address the source of the water if possible, such as turning off a leaking pipe or stopping a spill. Then, remove any standing water and move furniture off the wet carpet to prevent further damage and staining. Good ventilation is crucial; open windows and use fans to start the drying process. For extensive water damage, especially if the water has been present for more than 24-48 hours or is from a contaminated source, it's vital to contact a professional water damage restoration service to prevent mold growth and ensure proper drying and sanitization.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, stop the water source, remove standing water, and move furniture. For extensive damage or prolonged wetness, contact a professional restoration service.
